title: A NICE WAY TO COOK TOMATOES FOR BREAKFAST
instructions: .--A nice way to cook tomatoes for breakfast is to slice them, salt and pepper them, sprinkle with bread crumbs, a little butter on them, and broiled. Serve very hot immediately, without letting them stand.
